## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Dutiyasīla Sutta* (Iti 33; PTS It 26) is a short discourse located in the second chapter (Dukanipāta) of the *Itivuttaka* [SuttaCentral]. The text presents the brief doctrinal teaching that a person endowed with auspicious ethical conduct (*sīla*) and auspicious views (*diṭṭhi*) is destined for rebirth in heaven [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral lists a direct parallel to the sutta in the Chinese translation of the *Itivuttaka* (*Benshi jing*), cataloged at T 765.70 under the theme of ethics and view (戒、見) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus detects extensive Pali-internal text reuse across 14 texts, exhibiting near-total textual overlap with the preceding *Paṭhamasīla Sutta* (Iti 32, sharing segments §0.1–4.1) and sharing significant thematic passages with the *Catukkanipāta* (AN 4, §2.1–2.4) and the *Tikanipāta* (AN 3) of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya*, as well as the *Kammakkhandhaka* of the Vinaya Piṭaka (Kd 11) [DharmaNexus]. Formulaic opening or thematic material is further shared with other discourses in the *Itivuttaka*, including Iti 59, Iti 55, and Iti 28 [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records automated alignments with the Tibetan *Puṇyabala-avadāna* (D 347) and the Chinese *Ekottarika-āgama* (T 125) [DharmaNexus].

The text has been translated into fifteen languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato titled "Ethics (2nd)" [SuttaCentral].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
